title.narrative: Monitoring de protection et sensibilisation des communautés sur les risques de violations de droits du fait de la sécheresse.

description.narrative: The main objective of this $400,000 UNHCR project is to sensitize persons within the mandate of UNHCR about preventing human rights violations linked to climate change and to reinforce protection monitoring mechanisms. To that end, UNHCR will deploy protection monitors, establish 4 referral mechanisms, reinforce community-based protection committees, traditional arbitration mechanisms and spaces for dialogue, train 200 people on protection issues in relation to climate change and raise awareness campaigns on protection and environmental issues to reach at least 3,000 people In total, UNHCR’s project targets 54.648 people, including 17,487 women and 6,558 girls. Among those targeted UNHCR expects to be 2,186 people with disabilities.
